Fixed

  • Plugin name is no longer translated in the admin menu, Plugins screen and MVweb Hub — it stays "MVweb Build Calc" (product brand name), matching the other MVweb plugins. The Russian description is kept.
  • MVweb Hub header (studio info and the "Visit our website" button) is now translated: bundled the missing `mvweb-hub` textdomain catalogue (`includes/languages/mvweb-hub-ru_RU.mo`). Since this plugin loads first and wins the newest-wins menu loader, the hub rendered its copy and showed English strings without it.
